items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And this gentleman came up to the bus and asked me if my mother's name was Ruby Moody... and my grandmother's name was Maddie Hamm... and he said, 'Well, I'm your father.'

ctx.x: And this gentleman came up to the bus and asked me if my mother's name was Ruby Moody [phonetic sp.] and if my grandfather's name was James Hamm [phonetic sp.] and my grandmother's name was Maddie Hamm [phonetic sp.], and I told him, "Yeah." Everything was
affirmative and he said, "Well, I'm your father." You know. [indiscernible] I said, "Well, what know, pop?"
